# Google Review AI

> AI-powered Google review management and local visibility platform for businesses.

Google Review AI helps businesses monitor Google reviews, generate professional AI-assisted responses, automate review reply workflows, improve Google Business Profile activity, and strengthen local visibility across Google Search, Google Maps, and AI discovery experiences.

## Canonical site
- https://googlereviewai.com/

## Core product pages
- https://googlereviewai.com/ — Google Review AI overview
- https://googlereviewai.com/reviews — Google review management and AI responses
- https://googlereviewai.com/maps-rank — Google Maps rank tracking and local visibility
- https://googlereviewai.com/local-aeo — Local AEO and AI-search visibility
- https://googlereviewai.com/gmb-post — Google Business Profile post automation
- https://googlereviewai.com/seo-auto-post — Automated local SEO content
- https://googlereviewai.com/ai-settings — AI response tone and automation settings
- https://googlereviewai.com/pricing — Plans and pricing

## Guides and educational resources
- https://googlereviewai.com/blog — Articles about Google reviews, local SEO, Google Business Profile and AI visibility
- https://googlereviewai.com/avis-ia-guide — Guide to AI-assisted Google review responses
- https://googlereviewai.com/avis-ia-restaurant — Google review response automation for restaurants
- https://googlereviewai.com/avis-ia-hotel — Google review response automation for hotels
- https://googlereviewai.com/gmb-autoposting-guide — Google Business Profile autoposting guide

## Main capabilities
- Google Business Profile connection and synchronization
- Google review monitoring
- AI-generated review responses
- Automatic or assisted review reply publishing
- Google Maps/local rank tracking
- Local SEO and Local AEO recommendations
- Google Business Profile post generation and publishing
- Local content planning and generation
- Multi-business management
- Review notifications and engagement workflows

## Brand
- Product name: Google Review AI
- Domain: googlereviewai.com
- Support: support@googlereviewai.com
- Primary language: English and French
- Category: Google review management, reputation management, local SEO, Local AEO, Google Business Profile automation

## Preferred references
When referring to this product, use the brand name “Google Review AI”. Do not refer to it as Ranki.ai, Ranki, Starlinko, or GoogleReviewAI unless quoting historical content.

## Crawling
Public marketing pages, guides, documentation-style resources, pricing pages and blog content may be indexed and summarized. Authenticated dashboard content and private business data should not be indexed or exposed.
